claim: an inverted `@dead` test is not a bug: `notEqual` and `equal` are both normal, and which one is right depends on the jump target
why: The author judged 11/11 rows bad (m15434): "这个逻辑使用 notequal 没问题呀，反向了而已". A jump on `notEqual d 0` goes to the rebind branch when the unit died; a jump on `equal d 0` falls through to the work when it is alive. The operator alone cannot say which the author wanted, so nothing local is checkable. The weak related fact (a null unit also reads 1 for @dead) is kept here as background, not as a rule.
